title: The guard asks about the job
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The guard asks where he goes Tuesdays now. Wood says a frame shop. The guard says his wife had a thing framed there once. Wood asks what. The guard says he never looked. Wood says that's most of them.

panels.composition: Lot C. The GUARD at the Datsun's window, casual, a thermos. WOOD. BARNABY.

balloons.text: Wife had a thing framed there.

a young man's face, interested despite himself, black and white, no words
a security guard's face, plain, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The guard walking off. Wood, to the dog. The lot. Most of them.

notes: 'Never looked.' The guard's wife's thing: the town's walls are full of things nobody looked at.
